title: Borrow-token composition and dust-pool economics: why a USD-denominated dust filter is not evaluable on Robinhood Chain
driver: User proposal: filter pools whose capacity USD value cannot cover Gas (MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD_USD), and hard-blacklist dust pools

verdict.summary: The economic argument is accepted and is now encoded as D4-d (token-denominated economic floor) and D4-e (dust blacklist scoped to economic infeasibility only). The proposed USD conversion is rejected because 86 of 88 production closed loops borrow stock tokens (SPY/GOOGL/SPCX/CRCL/MU), which have no reliable on-chain USD price, and because the user previously locked the depth criterion to be token-denominated with zero USD dependency.

borrowTokenComposition.source: production DB v4_closed_loop_hops joined with chain_tokens (read-only)
borrowTokenComposition.conclusion: 42 of 88 loops (47.7%) borrow stock tokens, and 86 of 88 (97.7%) borrow a token that is neither ETH nor a USD stablecoin. A USD value for the binding capacity therefore cannot be computed from any on-chain source for the large majority of the active book.

candidatePoolDecimals.source: rehearsal copy DB, 94 candidate pools with measured capacity
candidatePoolDecimals.note: 6-decimal pools are the canonical USDG 0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168; pricing and stable-coin detection must be by address, not symbol

currentBindingFloor.problem: calibrated on the smallest position the system ever attempted, not on economic feasibility

D4-d.name: token-denominated economic floor as an admission gate
D4-d.formula: cap_path = min(binding_capacity[hop]); required_amt = gas_profit / unit_profit; if cap_path < required_amt -> reject path before the 24-step search
D4-d.reuse: same structure as existing capacity_covers_amount() / required_amount_for_profit(), promoted from post-check to admission gate
D4-d.limitation: unit_profit is currently only obtainable from the on-chain eth_call preview, so the static floor must use a conservative unit-profit assumption until ARCH-2 (off-chain 3-hop simulator) lands

D4-e.name: scoped dust blacklist
D4-e.scope: pools whose capacity cannot cover Gas are removed from the review/broadcast path as dust_unprofitable, but remain in the candidate set for human observation
D4-e.explicitlyForbidden: blacklisting a pool solely because its USD value is low; that would require the forbidden USD price source

acceptedRevisions.hardConstraintRespected: D4-e removes POOLS on capacity-and-Gas grounds, never TOKEN PAIRS on TVL grounds

constraintsRespected: production DB was opened read-only via file:...?mode=ro
daemon and run.py (PID 30304) were not stopped or restarted
the zero-USD dependency decision remains in force
